Multi-year overview shows EBIT increased from SEK 60.7 million to SEK 73.5 million.

factual_claims.claim: Total revenue increased 9.8% to SEK 239.7 million, while net revenue from electricity sales rose 9.9% to SEK 203.2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'Revenues amounted to SEK 239.7 (218.3) million, an increase of 9.8 percent compared with the previous year.' 'Net revenue amounted to SEK 203.2 (184.8) million, an increase of 9.9 percent compared with the previous year.'

factual_claims.claim: Other operating income increased to SEK 36.5 million, including SEK 32.7 million in subsidies.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'Other operating income amounted to SEK 36.5 (33.5) million.' Note 4: 'Subsidies for green electricity [were] SEK 32,667 (32,044) million.'

factual_claims.claim: Revenue growth was driven by higher electricity production, although it was partly offset by lower average prices caused by a greater share of electricity sold to the grid, revised tariffs and currency effects.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'The increase is attributable to higher production, but is simultaneously negatively impacted by lower average prices as a result of a higher share of electricity sold to the grid, as well as revised tariffs during the second half of the year and a weaker currency.'

factual_claims.claim: Reported currency effects reduced total revenue by SEK 18.0 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'Currency effects impacted revenues by SEK -18.0 (-4.5) million.'

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses rose 5.5% to SEK 166.2 million, mainly reflecting the larger installed base, higher depreciation and increased maintenance costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'Operating expenses amounted to SEK 166.2 (157.6) million, an increase of 5.5 percent.' Note 6: 'The increased costs are primarily driven by a larger installed base, resulting in higher scheduled depreciation and increased maintenance of solar PV installations.'

factual_claims.claim: Despite this, EBITDA increased from SEK 145.8 million to SEK 163.7 million, with the margin improving from 67% to 68%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: EBIT rose 21.1% to SEK 73.5 million, and the EBIT margin increased from 28% to 31%, demonstrating improved underlying operating profitability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'Operating profit amounted to SEK 73.5 (60.7) million, an increase of 21.1 percent compared with the previous year.' Multi-year overview: 'EBIT% [2025] 31% [2024] 28%'.

factual_claims.claim: Interest expenses and similar charges declined from SEK 88.7 million to SEK 82.0 million as refinancing in China progressed.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'Interest expenses and similar profit/loss items amounted to SEK 82.0 (88.7) million.' Note 18: 'The refinancing in China with Agricultural Bank continues to reduce interest expenses.'

factual_claims.claim: However, a SEK 3.8 million negative currency difference and a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million affected the bottom line.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'The exchange rate difference amounted to SEK -3.8 (1.8) million.' 'Profit after tax amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million.' Note 2: 'Profit after tax... were impacted by a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3.8 (1.8) million as well as a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Profit after tax improved to a loss of SEK 7.2 million from a loss of SEK 32.9 million in 2024, while earnings per share improved from SEK -0.58 to SEK -0.13.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'Profit after tax amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million.' Note 24: 'Earnings per share for the period before dilution, SEK [2025] -0.13 [2024] -0.58'.

factual_claims.claim: Operationally, Gigasun installed 55.7 MW during the year, bringing revenue-generating capacity to 395.8 MW at year-end, up from 340.1 MW.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'In 2025, the company installed a total of 55.7 (57.5) MW of roof-based solar energy facilities and had 395.8 (340.1) MW installed and revenue-generating capacity at the end of the year.'

factual_claims.claim: The portfolio comprised 216 installations, compared with 200 previously.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operations section: 'As of December 31, 2025, Gigasun has a portfolio of 216 (200) electricity-generating solar energy installations...'

factual_claims.claim: Electricity generation increased 30% to 327.8 million kWh, reducing CO2-related emissions by approximately 161,000 tonnes.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'During the year, 327.8 (252.6) million kWh were produced, an increase with 30 percent... reducing CO2-related emissions by approximately 161,000 (124,000) tonnes.'

factual_claims.claim: The company signed 17 contracts representing approximately 41.8 MW, although signed orders at year-end declined to 18.9 MW from 38.8 MW.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'The Company signed 17 (15) contracts representing total installed capacity of 41.7 (56.6) MW.' 'At the end of 2025, the company had 16.4 (38.8) MW in signed orders.'

factual_claims.claim: Financing remained a central focus.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'The company continued the strategic review initiated in 2024 with the goal of securing capital for the company’s long-term growth objectives...' Note 2: 'The strategic overview initiated in 2024 continues... management and the Board of Directors judge that new financing can be secured in 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: Gigasun secured additional refinancing of approximately SEK 372 million, in addition to the SEK 870 million agreed in 2024, at an interest rate of 3.60% and with a ten-year amortization period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'The company has entered into an agreement with the Chinese company Agricultural Bank Financial Leasing Co., Ltd to refinance an additional SEK 372 million (CNY 280 million). The capital will primarily be used to repay the sale and leaseback facility... The interest rate on the new financing is 3.60% and the amortization period has been extended from 7 to 10 years.'

factual_claims.claim: The SOLT4 bond was extended to 8 November 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'The remaining bond, SOLT4, has been extended to November 8, 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: Interest-bearing debt declined to SEK 1,382.6 million from SEK 1,483.1 million, but the equity ratio fell to 21% from 23%, and cash decreased to SEK 45.1 million from SEK 89.9 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance Sheet: 'Interest-bearing debt [2025] 1,382,613 [2024] 1,483,061'. 'Equity ratio [2025] 21% [2024] 23%'. 'Cash and bank balances [2025] 45,149 [2024] 89,889'.

factual_claims.claim: The Group’s cash flow was negative at SEK 34.9 million, reflecting continued investment in solar facilities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flow: 'Cash flow for the period [2025] -34,902 [2024] 68,305'. Note 19: 'Investment activities generated a cash flow of SEK -208.1 (-289.6) million, which for the most part consists of investment in ongoing and new solar panels.'

factual_claims.claim: Management states that securing further financing in 2026 remains important to support the business plan and continued operations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 2: 'The strategic overview initiated in 2024 continues and management and the Board of Directors judge that new financing can be secured in 2026... If the company is not successful with new financing, the company believes that there is significant uncertainty regarding going concern in the current business plan.'
